name: INEX ONE
description: Expert network marketplace for expert calls and B2B surveys, with centralized project management, compliance tools, billing, and AI transcript analysis.
pricingDetail: Listed prices as of 2026-11-11: $500 per one-time project plus expert call costs; Corporate $2,500/year plus usage; Enterprise custom pricing. Surveys and transcript-library AI are listed in Corporate and above.
keyDifferentiators: Multi-network expert access under one contract
Private transcript library with AI analysis

compliance.mnpiPolicy: Inex One says partner training must prohibit disclosure of material non-public information.
compliance.expertVetting: Inex One says partners must verify expert identity, professional background, and conflicts of interest.

overview:
INEX ONE is an expert network marketplace founded in 2018 and headquartered in Stockholm. It enables consulting firms, private equity teams, asset managers, and corporations to centralize expert calls, survey projects, and research records across multiple providers.

The company reports access to 30+ expert networks and 20+ survey firms. Clients compare expert profiles, schedule calls, track spending, and manage billing in one platform. Its AI tools support transcription, summaries, and analysis of private transcript libraries.

As of this review, Inex One reports 8,000+ users across 800+ companies. On October 19, 2026, it announced a self-serve plan for buyers with occasional expert interview needs.

history.narrative:
INEX ONE was founded in 2018 by Max Friberg, Filip Gruvstad, Josefine Vinberg, and Mehdi Rejraji. Its 2021 funding announcement describes Friberg and Gruvstad as former McKinsey consultants and Vinberg and Rejraji as having technology backgrounds. The company announced a $3 million round on August 30, 2021. The announcement lists former senior partners from consulting firms, private equity firms Advent International, Accent, and Triton Partners, and existing investor Curitas Ventures among the investors. This does not establish that the consulting firms themselves invested.

Inex One says Friberg previously co-founded Previro in 2016, sold it to Workvi in early 2018, and that Workvi sold the business to Knowledge Gate in late 2019. The platform is provided by AB Leverache, a Swedish company identified in its privacy policy.

timeline.event: Founded by Max Friberg, Filip Gruvstad, Josefine Vinberg, and Mehdi Rejraji.
Announced $3 million in funding from new and existing investors.
Company reported rank #134 in the FT 1000 2025 list, with revenue growth above 1,100% over 2020–2023.
Updated its market-sizing report, estimating global expert network revenue at approximately $3 billion in 2025.
Announced inclusion in the FT 1000 2026 ranking.
Reported rank #65 in Sifted’s Nordic startup growth list, €14 million revenue in 2025, and €4.4 million raised.
Launched self-serve expert network access on October 19, with a $500 project fee plus call costs.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Network Marketplace
servicesDetailed.description: Clients submit a project, compare expert profiles from partner networks, screen candidates, and schedule interviews in a shared calendar. Inex One lists consolidated invoicing across networks.

servicesDetailed.name: Compliance Dashboard
servicesDetailed.description: Inex One describes customizable screening questions, automated approval or rejection rules, review queues, communication oversight, and audit trails for expert calls.

servicesDetailed.name: Spend Tracking
servicesDetailed.description: The expert-call platform tracks spending alongside call activity and consolidates billing by project. Automated cost-optimization recommendations were not verified.

servicesDetailed.name: Survey Project Management
servicesDetailed.description: Clients compare survey providers’ quotes, timelines, feasibility, and methodologies before awarding work. Inex One says it recommends vendors based on specialties and similar projects.

servicesDetailed.name: Knowledge Repository
servicesDetailed.description: Inex One offers a private library of call transcripts with project permissions, semantic search, and AI analysis across interviews.

servicesDetailed.name: AI Transcription & LLM Chat
servicesDetailed.description: Inex One says calls are transcribed within 15 minutes, with summaries and timestamped quotes. It lists transcription and summaries as free with expert calls; library chat availability depends on the plan.

servicesDetailed.name: Industry Research & Market Reports
servicesDetailed.description: Inex One publishes expert network market-sizing research and a public expert network directory. Its February 9, 2026 update estimates the industry at approximately $3 billion in 2025; this is the provider’s estimate.

aiPlatform.narrative: Inex One describes AI tools for summarizing and analyzing expert call transcripts, including natural-language queries across interviews and concept-based search. Its MCP server provides access from compatible AI tools. Public sources reviewed did not substantiate AI expert matching, AI network routing based on historical performance, or automated spend optimization.
features: Structured quotes, lists, and data tables
MCP access for compatible AI clients

complianceExtended.narrative: Inex One describes three lines of defense: partner vetting and standardized rules, central client oversight, and global monitoring. These are company-described controls, not an independent assessment of their effectiveness.
highlights: Company says partners must recertify compliance annually
Custom screening questions and approval rules
Centralized expert profiles and communication records
Company reports ISO 27001-aligned information security management verified by third-party audits
Company says hosting providers hold SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications

clientFit.narrative: Inex One markets the platform to organizations using expert interviews and B2B surveys. Its October 2026 self-serve launch also targets occasional users, including independent consultants, corporate strategy professionals, and mid-market investors.
segments: Hedge funds, banks, and asset managers

strengths: Multi-network profiles, scheduling, and billing in one platform
Private research library with AI analysis
Self-serve project access alongside annual plans
caveats: Platform access fees are additional to expert call costs
Surveys and library AI require Corporate or Enterprise under the listed plans
Expert recruitment is performed by partner networks
Inex One says the platform is not optimized for focus groups, CX analysis, or social listening
Inex One says it does not replace a strategy consulting firm
notableFacts: Company reports an NPS score of 90 for Q4 2025; independently comparable industry rankings were not verified.
Current About page lists offices in Stockholm, Raleigh, Paris, and Singapore.
Company identifies Richard Thornton as a board member and Brad Brown and Ajay Gupta as board observers.

In its seller-written G2 overview, Inex One reports serving 7 of the top-10 strategy consulting firms, 4 of the top-10 private equity firms, and 8 of the top-10 market research firms; the ranking methodology is not supplied.

Company LinkedIn updates read on 2026-11-11 announce Microsoft Teams notifications and welcome Gourav Nayak as Head of Insights; they display relative ages of 1 month and 3 months respectively, without exact announcement dates.
